content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling new homes with mortgages; it does not lease merchandise to consumers with limited credit."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling new single-family homes and townhomes; no lease-to-own or merchandise rental model."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Pawn lender with secured loans and used goods resale; it lacks lease-to-own payment plans on new merchandise."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel operator selling groceries to households; no leasing of durable goods or consumer credit."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling homes with in-house mortgage and insurance services; different product and customer model."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Lease-to-own payment plans for furniture, electronics and appliances bought by credit-limited consumers via retail and online partners."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Industrial real estate landlord leasing warehouses to businesses; no consumer merchandise or lease-to-own business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Self-storage landlord renting storage units; no merchandise leasing or lease-purchase financing to consumers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Propane and fuel oil distributor delivering energy by truck; no lease-to-own retail or consumer finance activity."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling single-family and active adult homes; lacks rent-to-own retail and lease-purchase financing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Home furnishings retailer selling outright through stores and websites; no lease-to-own or consumer lease financing."}]}
